About Us

A Private Sanctuary of Wellness

JJ Wellness Spa was created for those who value calm, privacy, and exceptional care. We bring professional massage therapy and wellness experiences directly to you — whether at home, in a hotel, or at another mutually agreed location across Uganda.

Every session is tailored to your needs. We prioritise your comfort, maintain the highest standards of professionalism and discretion, and create a peaceful atmosphere wherever the appointment takes place.

Our focus is simple: to help you unwind, restore balance, and leave feeling renewed.

The Experience

How Booking Works

Simple, private, and professional. Availability and travel depend on your location.

01

Choose Your Treatment

Browse our services and decide which massage or wellness experience you would like.

02

Contact Us on WhatsApp

Send a message with your preferred service, date, time, and location.

03

Share Your Details

Tell us where you would like the session (home, hotel, or other agreed place) and any special requests.

04

Confirm Arrangements

We will confirm availability, provide pricing, and finalise all details with you.

05

Enjoy Your Session

Relax and experience professional care in the comfort and privacy of your chosen location.

Please note: We operate as a mobile service across Uganda. Coverage depends on location, travel feasibility, and current availability. All appointments are confirmed only after mutual agreement.
